name: Virginia Packing
old_description: Virginia Packing is a specialty co-packer for cured meats, cheeses and other quality foods. We specialize in products that require careful handling and extra attention to detail.
about:
Virginia Packing operates from Toano, Virginia, where it was founded in 2011. The company is a specialty co-packer focused on cured meats, cheeses, and other quality foods that require careful handling and extra attention to detail.

The facility is USDA and FDA inspected and SQF certified. It houses a Weber high-speed slicer and a GEA thermoforming packaging machine, enabling high-speed precision slicing, deboning, modified atmosphere packaging (MAP), vacuum and shrink packaging, and hand-cutting of specialty cheeses. The company also provides air-conditioned, refrigerated, and frozen storage along with cross-docking logistics, leveraging proximity to the Hampton Roads ports and Interstate 95.

Virginia Packing serves the food processing industry, particularly producers of cured meats, cheeses, sausages, and specialty items. A noted client is La Tienda, the leading online retailer for Spanish imports, for whom Virginia Packing acts as the exclusive slicer and packer of Spanish jamón.

The company positions itself as large enough to feature top-quality equipment and facilities, yet small enough to take special care of each product, emphasizing careful handling and exact specifications for every job.
